_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate dominates: 30d momentum and funding locked mid-band with no spike, so the skilled call is hold the current Hope rung until a breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: partial split — analyst explicit HOLD/coil; narrative silent on forward phase (descriptive only); consensus forces HOLD and clamps predicted_phase to ±1
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound with btc_momentum_30d and funding inside 40-60 and no funding spike
next_move.invalidated_if: Range break that drives btc_momentum_30d out of 40-60 or funding toward ~75 (2019-top zone)
